chunks: And that this is My straight path, so follow it; and do not follow the other ways, lest you should turn away from His way. That is what He has commanded you, so that you may become righteous.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'My straight path' in Surah Al-An'am?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as establishing the 'Sirat al-Mustaqim' not merely as a general path, but specifically as the path of the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams, who are the true guides after the Prophet. The warning against 'subul' (plural paths) highlights the danger of sectarian fragmentation (fitna) that arises when the community deviates from the singular, divinely appointed authority. This underscores the Shia emphasis on following the infallible Imams as the practical manifestation of God's straight path to attain true Taqwa.
